---
title: "早期历史输入：原市场概率归档接入"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  config: null
---

从显式迁移凭据读取历史归档，复用既有比分投射函数。
不重新训练，不读取结算，不将战力概率误当市场概率。
本阶段保留原市场概率，后续与冻结校正市场阶段分开标记。

```{r}
library(dplyr)
cfg<-jsonlite::fromJSON(params$config);root<-cfg$repository_root
reticulate::use_python(cfg$python,required=TRUE)
code_files<-c('r/fundamentals_pure_baseline.R','quarto/230_eight_strategy_early_inputs.qmd')
code<-setNames(lapply(code_files,function(f)digest::digest(file=file.path(root,f),algo='sha256')),code_files)
source(file.path(root,'r/fundamentals_pure_baseline.R'))
api<-reticulate::import('src.data_archive')
prov<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.provenance')
closure<-prov$implementation_closure(reticulate::import('pathlib')$Path(root),
 list('src.data_archive'),distributions=list())
stopifnot(!dir.exists(cfg$output))
frames<-list();cuts<-list();excluded<-list();sources<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(cfg$sources))) {
 e<-cfg$sources[i,]
 bytes<-api$read_archive_members(e$archive,list(e$member),expected_sha256=e$archive_sha256)[[e$member]]
 text<-bytes$decode('utf-8')
 d<-jsonlite::fromJSON(text)
 sources[[e$member]]<-list(archive=e$archive,archive_sha256=e$archive_sha256,
   member_sha256=digest::digest(charToRaw(text),serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256'))
 if(e$kind=='prediction') {
  control<-d$selected;control$fixtures<-control$fixtures |> filter(scenario=='baseline')
  ready<-d$market$status |> filter(status=='READY') |> select(issue,slot,provider_id)
  excluded[[e$member]]<-anti_join(control$fixtures,ready,by=c('issue','slot','provider_id')) |>
    select(issue,slot,provider_id) |> mutate(reason='ARCHIVED_MARKET_NOT_READY')
  control$fixtures<-semi_join(control$fixtures,ready,by=c('issue','slot','provider_id'))
  f<-pure_baseline_factors(control,d$market,control$cutoffs)
  native<-control$cutoffs
 } else {
  stopifnot(e$kind=='factors');f<-as_tibble(d$rows);native<-d$cutoffs
 }
 f<-f |> filter(issue<cfg$before_issue)
 # Explicit RAW market foundation, shared across all eight early-period arms.
 # Stored p values from the archived strength models are not used.
 for(direction in c('W','D','L'))f[[paste0('p_',direction)]]<-f[[paste0('q_',direction)]]
 f<-f |> select(issue,slot,provider_id,handicap,p_W,p_D,p_L,q_W,q_D,q_L)
 stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(f[c('issue','slot')]))
 frames[[e$member]]<-f
 for(id in unique(f$issue)) {
  stopifnot(is.null(cuts[[id]]))
  cuts[[id]]<-native[[id]][as.character(f$slot[f$issue==id])]
 }
}
frame<-bind_rows(frames)
stopifnot(nrow(frame)>0,!anyDuplicated(frame[c('issue','slot')]))
for(id in unique(frame$issue)) {
 f<-filter(frame,issue==id)
 stopifnot(length(cuts[[id]])==nrow(f),!any(vapply(cuts[[id]],is.null,logical(1))))
}
stopifnot(identical(code,setNames(lapply(code_files,function(f)digest::digest(file=file.path(root,f),algo='sha256')),code_files)))
dir.create(cfg$output,recursive=TRUE)
jsonlite::write_json(list(rows=frame,cutoffs=cuts,issues=sort(unique(frame$issue)),
 probability_version='ARCHIVED_RAW_MARKET',sources=sources,historical_admission=FALSE,
 status='INPUTS_ONLY_PENDING_CONTRACT_REPLAY',config=cfg,code=code,implementation=closure),
 file.path(cfg$output,'inputs.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,digits=NA,pretty=TRUE)
readr::write_csv(bind_rows(excluded),file.path(cfg$output,'excluded.csv'))
frame |> count(issue) |> knitr::kable()
```

这些输入仍需共享cutoff验证、候选重建与结算身份核对；输入导出不等于研究验收。
